execution_consumption: Requests are frozen inputs; scenario gold is evaluation-only and must not be imported before generation.

holdout_policy.exclusion_rule: No request text is reused from the 15-case development subset; each group carries a distinct holdout_basis and receives a static exact/near-text check.
holdout_policy.semantic_review_boundary: Static text checks cannot prove semantic non-paraphrase; human review remains required before execution.
